text:
maya: Overnight eval flagged several suites failing in the 02:00 run, looks like a coherent degradation across a small cohort. :warning:

eval-bot: Nightly run complete (commit abc1234). 6 suites failed, top hits: instructional-coherence-v2 (95% regression), shortseq-blanking (74% blank outputs), legal-snippet-hallucination (spike). Full report: https://internal.redwood/evals/4812345678

maya: tagging devon as primary oncall for eval regressions today @devon — initial severity P2 unless we see customer impact. Can we triage k/v cache + quant path first?

devon: on it. grabbing the eval diffs now. first glance -> failures concentrated on 8-16 token few-shot prompts. consistent with recent int4 rollout last night.

zane: is this the int4 bundle we promoted? I saw a small init flag flip in deploy at 01:45.

devon: yes, redwood-open-2.1-int4 was promoted to canary pools at 01:40. rollout metadata: 
```
deploy: redwood-open-2.1-int4
canary: 20% hosted-runtime
kernels: qkernel-v3
config: kvcache-enabled=true
```

sophia: quick datapoint — the coherence suite uses a mix of long context and few-shot seeds, so both quantization and kv cache ordering could interact. worth repro with int8 vs int4 locally.

ryan: I ran a tiny reproduction against the canary model, saw elevated short-answer blanks when prompts include multi-line system instructions. failing example below.
```
# repro script
python -m eval_runner --model redwood-open-2.1-int4 --suite instructional-coherence-v2 --seed 42 --prompt-id 117
```

devon: thanks ryan. I'll repro and capture token-level logits. if kv hits are misaligned, you'll see sudden probability collapse around token 3-5.

maya: action items: 1) devon reproduce + attach logs (owner) 2) zane check deploy rollback window / flag (backup) 3) sophia run eval with int8 build to confirm quant delta 4) ryan collect a short set of failing prompts for immediate canary block.

devon: started reproduce. attaching initial diff snapshot in a sec.

zane: rollback window open for 2h. if devon confirms int4 correlated, we should pause the canary and revert to redwood-open-2.1-int8. I'll standby for the thumbs. :thumbsup:

sophia: kicked off int8 run against the same seed. initial heatmap shows coherence metric intact on int8, early sign points to quantization regression.

devon: logs: token probs collapse on a small subset where the model emits linebreaks after system bullet points. snippet: "prob(token=
) drops from 0.28 -> 0.001". Uploading logs to /tmp/eval-4812345678/logs.tar.gz

maya: good find. let's not flip anything yet until we confirm reproducibility on a pinned environment. devon, can you capture a minimal promptset (5 examples) that reproduce locally with docker image redwood/serve:ci-2026-03-20-int4?

devon: yes. will push a tiny test vector to the eval repo under experiments/4812345678/. ETA 30m.

ryan: posting 5 failing prompts (sanitized) in the thread for quick eyeball so infra can block canary fast if needed:
1) "Summarize the following instruction set:
- Do X
- Then Y
"
2) "Explain why the following line should be executed:
for i in range(n):..."
3) "Is the following statement legally defensible? [clipped]"
4) "Convert this list to steps:
* step one
* step two"
5) "Refactor this short snippet to be more explicit"

sophia: repeating with int8 shows no blanks for those prompts. quant path suspects rising.

maya: ok we have correlation: int4 canary introduced, int8 stable. devon please attach the test vectors + logits + a short README to the experiment folder. zane hold the rollback flag until we confirm the mitigation path (hotfix quant kernel or temporary pause).

devon: uploaded: https://internal.redwood/git/evals/experiments/4812345678. I've also started a kv-cache-only run (int4 but kvcache-disabled) to isolate the cache interaction.

eval-bot: KV-cache isolation run complete: int4 + kvcache-disabled -> blanks drop by 60% on the small repro set.

zane: that suggests a cache + quant interaction. priority now is to either disable kvcache for int4 or pin int8. Given rollback window, I'd favor pinning int8 for hosted canary while we investigate kernel.

maya: decision: pin hosted canary to int8 (redwood-open-2.1-int8) immediately for customer-facing pools. devon + sophia to continue root cause for int4+kvcache. zane will coordinate rollback and notify infra.

ryan: I'll prepare a short postmortem template if this ends up customer-impacting; for now mark incident P2 and ownership to devon/sophia.

devon: assigning tasks in the experiment repo. plan: 1) kernel debug -> zane 2) kvcache ordering unit tests -> sophia 3) quant kernel repro + traces -> devon. I'll post updates in this thread.

maya: thanks team — please update thread with any customer-facing notes. also ping me if you need a hot rollback earlier than planned. :white_check_mark:
